questions.question: Explain the difference between distance and displacement.

explanation.text: Distance is the total length of the path travelled, while displacement is the change in position from the initial point to the final point and has a specified direction.

questions.question: State Newton's second law of motion.

explanation.text: Newton's second law states that the rate of change of momentum of a body is proportional to the applied force and occurs in the direction of that force.

questions.question: Explain what is meant by uniform acceleration.

explanation.text: Uniform acceleration occurs when the velocity of a body changes by equal amounts in equal intervals of time.
